question: How many sellers are there in each state?
sql: SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS seller_count FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state ORDER BY seller_count DESC;

question: What is the total revenue generated by each seller?
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Who are the top 10 sellers by revenue?
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average product price sold by each seller?
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS average_price FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id ORDER BY average_price DESC;

question: Which sellers generated more than 10000 in revenue?
sql: SELECT s.seller_id, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS revenue FROM sellers s JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id HAVING SUM(oi.price) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;
